name: KJ's Return[read description]
desc:
The old game got discontinued, but we decided to continue again.

Creds: The Strongest Battleground, Fiction Battleground.
Controls:
G - ultimate mode 
G + walk - ultimate mode variant
F - block
Q - dash
B  - emote wheel
Shift - Shift-lock
Left click -  punch


You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE, ETC.)
Show your support by liking and favoriting the experience to receive updates.
